'''Hazel VS Almond!''' (Japanese: '''マロンVSアーモンド!''', ''{{tt|Marron|Hazel}} VS Almond!'') is the sixty-second chapter of [[Magical Pokémon Journey]].

==Plot==
{{incomplete plot}}
[[Grandpa]]'s holding another contest. This time, it's to see who can find {{p|Natu}}—if [[Ginger]] finds out he lost her precious Pokémon, she'll be furious! There are two possible prizes—a fishing rod and a [[Star Piece]]—so both [[Hazel]] and [[Almond]] are competing.
